statement: A slug MUST be bounded at 60 characters.
input_text: Should the reconciliation service retry failed settlement batches automatically or escalate them to an operator queue
note: The source question is well over 60 characters. The slug MUST be at most 60. An implementation that omits the bound produces the non-conformant slug shown -- a filename long enough to trip path-length limits on some filesystems, and unreadable in a directory listing.
